forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 34 of August, teams completed 1 zone survey, 2 visits and 1 clearance; no technical surveys were completed. COC-Z09 was declared free this week. So far, 24 zones have been surveyed, 9 declared free, 26 areas released and 12 cleared. Mines have been found in 8 areas; 574 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held or queried. The access feed shows 10 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the current plan is P08. Rain or wind cost 6 team-days.

The week 32 forecast covers the zones of the plan it was made with and counts what is already done. Its P10 to P90 range is 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 11 zones declared free this season.
